title: Mediterranean Garlic Chicken Bake
description: A deliciously flavored chicken bake with a mix of Mediterranean spices and savory garlic. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together garlic, Mediterranean seasoning, and bake seasoning (if using).
Brush the kissed oil on both sides of the chicken breast.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the garlic-herb mixture evenly over the chicken breast.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
